gloss_chirho: † [תּוּב]  vb. return (𝔗 Syriac; BH שׁוּב);—Pe.  Impf. 3 ms. יְתוּב, c. עַל pers., of brightness (זִיו) of face Dn 4:33b
† [תָּמַהּ]  vb. be astounded, dumb-founded (NH id.; so Aramaic תְּמַהּ, ܬܡܰܗ );—Qal  Pf. 3 pl. תָּמָ֑הוּ ψ 48:6; Impf.
† תַּ֫עַר  n.m. ψ 52:4 and (Is 7:20) f. razor, sheath;—1. a.  razor, abs. יְגַלַּח בְּת׳ Is 7:20 (fig.); subj. of לֹא יַ
† I. תַּפּוּחַ  n.[m.] apple-tree, apple (from aromatic scent (breath), Thes Lag BN 111, 129 Post (v. infr.); Arabic تُف
† תִּרְצָה  n.pr.f. et loc. (pleasure, beauty);—1.   f. daughter of Ṣelophehad of Gilead Nu 26:33; 27:1; 36:11; Jos 17:3
† [תְּשׁוּבָה]  n.f. return, answer;—1.  sf. וּתְשֻׁבָתוֹ הָרָמָ֫תָה 1 S 7:17 and his return was (= he returned) to Rama
